content:
marta: Quick question — how does dedicated reserved throughput get enforced when an org has multiple API keys? We saw one key hogging the pool yesterday.
aj: Right now the reservation is at tenant/org level. Keys share that pool by default.
zheng: But we have some codepaths that do per-key soft limits for fairness. That was intended for public tenants, not Dedicated.
samir: The customer observed a single key exhausting burst tokens and pushing others to 429. That shouldn't happen for Dedicated tenants.
elaine: Can you paste the tenant config? Might be a misconfigured isolation limit.
marta: here's the relevant config we saw in logs:
```
reserved_throughput_qps: 100
burst_capacity_tokens: 200
per_key_isolation: disabled
weighting: null
fallback_policy: immediate-429
```
aj: Aah. fallback_policy=immediate-429 is the culprit for UX. For Dedicated we want graceful spillover.
zheng: Proposed enforcement model: tenant-level reservation = guaranteed QPS. Within tenant, keys get a weighted share of reserved QPS (default even split) + a shared burst pool for short spikes.
samir: +1 for weighted shares. Some customers use many short-lived keys for microservices — even split is wrong.
elaine: We should surface key weights in Console. Right now ops has to open a ticket to change per-key behavior.
console-bot: new idea: add "Key shares" under Tenant > Throughput where you can drag sliders to allocate the reserved portion.
marta: Telemetry needs to tell us when a specific key hits its share vs when it hits tenant reserved limit. Right now metrics are too coarse.
aj: Suggested metrics: tenant_reserved_used, tenant_burst_tokens, key_reserved_used, key_burst_used, key_throttle_count.
zheng: Also emit an event when we evict a key from the shared burst pool: tenant.burst.evict {key, reason, timestamp}
samir: What should eviction policy be? LRU of keys that used most burst recently? Or smallest weight first?
elaine: Smallest weight first makes sense for fairness. LRU could punish steady services.
marta: UX question: when a key gets 429, console should show "throttled: reached key share" vs "throttled: tenant exhausted" — different action items.
aj: Implementation sketch: on request, check key_reserved_remaining. If >0 allow. Else check tenant_shared_burst_remaining and key.burst_quota_eligibility. If eligible, consume from tenant burst. Else 429.
zheng: Edge case: what if a single key is sending long-running streaming requests that keep connections open and occupy the reservation? Need inflight tracking per token.
samir: We already track inflight_tokens for streaming. For Dedicated we should reserve a fractional slot for streaming so it doesn't starve non-stream callers.
elaine: Console UX: show live "reserved headroom" and a per-key live bar. Also expose historical percent utilization for last 1h/24h.
ops-bot: NOTE: rolling this out will touch quota service and routing. Suggest feature-flag rollout per-region starting with eu-west-1.
marta: Rollout plan: start with opt-in tenants (beta flag) -> collect telemetry for 48h -> compare per-key fairness metric -> widen.
aj: We need a new telemetry signal fairness_ratio = median(key_utilization_share / key_weight). Target ~1.
zheng: If fairness_ratio < 0.5 for >1h, auto-lower per-key burst eligibility for offending keys.
samir: Also add alerting: tenant_shared_burst < 10% for >5m -> page oncall; we saw customer outages when burst pool drained unexpectedly.
elaine: Config surface: api/tenants/{id}/throughput with fields {reserved_qps, burst_capacity, per_key_weights, fallback_policy}
marta: Backwards compatibility: if per_key_weights absent => equal weights. If fallback_policy omitted, default to graceful-spill (queue small inflight) not immediate-429.
aj: Security note: per_key_weights should be writable by admin roles only; propagate changes to routing plane atomically.
zheng: Performance note: computing dynamic weights per request needs a fast in-memory cache. We'll add a versioned config and stamp requests with config_version.
console-bot: UI Mock: https://mockups.internal/redwood/throughput-keys (placeholder)
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staged rollout triggered for feature flag tenant_throughput_shares in eu-west-1 at 1981240000
marta: Any objections to the plan? We need this shipped before the next Dedicated customer onboarding.
aj: No objections. Will draft design doc and PRs.
zheng: I'll start a prototype for routing changes and the metrics emission.
samir: I'll own the console pieces + admin controls.
elaine: I'll add the alerts and SLO checks in paging rules.
marta: Great, thanks everyone. Filing follow-ups: design doc (marta), RFC (aj), telemetry schema (zheng).
ops-bot: Reminder: add migration notes for tenants with existing per-key rate hacks.
marta: Thanks — will ping when drafts are ready. :thumbsup:
